description: Écalle acceleration ⟺ Φ_b state-integral resummation of the bar-odd Q_β D-ladder (unowned item #1 of the 1ppQ path reassessment). Reuses the exact d_k (build_d_ladder, ORD 43/k≤21), phi_b saddle vol_of_m, and the merged #3818/#3839 negatives; measures four un-pinned things. M2: the 2-adic bar-parity split gives two DISTINCT divergence classes (C_odd≈0.05, C_even≈0.11, |Δ|≈0.06) ⇒ the 'no single Gevrey index' is consistent with a genuine TWO-LEVEL (accelero-summable) structure — two critical times, not one mis-specified order (per-parity fits still short/noisy at k≤21, consistent with undecidable-at-k21). M3: (k!)^{s1}(k!)^{s2}=(k!)^{s1+s2} ⇒ composing Borel–Leroy transforms stays in the additive monoid of orders and cannot reach a new critical time ⇒ a genuine non-commutative Écalle kernel is necessary (the fixed-order negative is not repairable by iteration). M4: the forward optimal-truncation resummed D(ũ)≈−0.01667 at the meridian is ANCHOR-BLIND to ~9 digits (muon vs proton ũ differ ~2e-9), and h·D≈−0.0035 reproduces NEITHER S(muon)=+0.0097 NOR S(proton)=−0.0395. M4b magnitude tension: the substrate meridian ũ≈0.0095 puts optimal truncation at k*~1e13, so a Stokes jump exp(−ρ/ũ) is ~1e-7..1e-27 — far too small to be the O(0.01) anchor-dependent S; on the SUBSTRATE branch the swing is not a Stokes ambiguity of this ladder. M5: the Φ_b saddle deficit 0.00940 ≈ |S(muon)| — a separate anchor-blind geometric handle on the |S| scale (bridge #3654). VERDICT: acceleration setup complete + two critical times = the two parity levels; the perturbative acceleration at the substrate meridian gives only an anchor-blind floor and does NOT reproduce S; the exact remaining gap is that the anchor-dependent c₃ is either the 1/ũ³ c₃-representational amplification (#3636) or the fibre-saddle (|q|=1, ũ~O(1)) Stokes datum A_ω where the jump is unsuppressed (the G0 branch-mismatch / G3 monodromy datum) — NOT produced here. Scope-(a); no c_k wired; no fit; no tier change; L2 count unchanged (2/7).
